 Bangladesh: Garment workers protest demanding Tk30,000 minimum wage increase
 ⓘ 
 Mamunur Rashid, Shutterstock (licensed) 
 Garments workers of Achieve Fashion stage a demonstration in Dhaka, Bangladesh, on February 27, 2023 
 In August 2026, garment workers across Bangladesh staged protests demanding a minimum wage increase to TK 30,000, as unions and labour organisations demanded the formation of the Minimum Wage Board, following an amendment made to the Bangladesh Labour Act in April 2026, which reduced the wage-review process down to three years from five. Workers stated that the minimum wage of Tk 12,500 set in December 2023 had done little to enable workers to meet their basic needs, amid inflation and rising costs.
 In October 2026, it was reported the Department of Labour had begun taking steps to form the Minimum Wage Board following the protests.
